# Hero colors: archived variants

Source: [Hero color reference table](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8507); page edited 2026-03-17. Evidence: archived documentation; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/8507.md#wiki-8507) before using these values.

Table and quick-copy array conflict: Hanzo green 180/179, Symmetra red 145/45, Mei red 109/09. Preserve these disagreements until checked.

Array stops at Vendetta; the table contains later heroes. Source ordering is tied to its All Heroes snapshot and is not a stable future index contract.

Store explicit hero-to-color associations instead of assuming the archived array matches a current hero order.
